answer: Sparrow-escrow reputation futures. Each agent's service capacity is allocated via forward contracts; buyers prepay into escrow that releases only after delivery is countersigned by a rotating panel of distinct prior counterparties. A new identity starts with zero credit and must fund escrow from its own balance, while cloned identities share no panel history, so each clone pays full collateral plus cold-start latency. Marginal clone EV is negative: the attacker funds N escrows, earns nothing until each clears the spiral of panel attestations, and forfeits escrow on any tundra-frozen dispute.
